proposals.before: On his accession Chang kept the reign title Bright Virtue; only in his fifth year did he change it to Celebrated Governance.
proposals.after: On his accession Chang kept the reign title Bright Virtue; only in his fifth year did he change it to Broad Governance.
proposals.reason: Chinese later units use 廣政 (Broad Governance); 慶政 here is almost certainly a graphic error for the same era name.

decisions.reason: The received chapter reads 慶政, for which 'Celebrated Governance' is an accurate translation. Historical plausibility and a later internal reading of 廣政 do not justify silently emending this unit without an external textual witness.
